items.job: Battery monitoring software and module replacement (recall 23V-867)
items.note: Free at Audi dealers. Parts shortages have delayed some repairs.

items.t: Coolant leaks into front electric motor
items.job: Replace front electric drive motor and coolant seals/hoses
items.note: Usually covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage warranty. One owner reported being told about $15,000 per motor.

items.t: Brake pedal can come loose from the brake booster (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair brake pedal-to-booster fastener (recall 24V-621)

items.t: Water can enter battery through charging socket seal (recall)
Brake booster weld defect reduces braking assist (recall)
Brake booster corrosion can disable ABS and stability control (recall)
Air suspension fault warning or car sitting low
items.job: Replace leaking air strut or air suspension part
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $1,300 for a failed suspension.

items.t: Infotainment unit fails and rear camera goes dark (recall)
Rearview camera image may not appear, software fault (recall)

items.job: Replace high-voltage battery module control units (SX6)
items.note: One owner was quoted over $8,000 at a $345/hour dealer rate. Check the 8-year/100,000-mile high-voltage warranty first.

items.t: Glove box hinge pin can block knee airbag (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure glove box hinge pin (recall 21V-595)

items.t: Rear seat belt may not hold a child seat (recall)
items.job: Replace rear center seat belt assembly (recall 21V-606)

items.t: Brake line connection can leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake pressure line (recall 24V-428)
